rivals.reason: The 2019 Camaro SS competes directly with the Mustang GT, offering a powerful V8 engine and a distinctive aggressive exhaust note.
The Challenger R/T features a similar muscle car ethos with a robust V8 engine and a celebrated rumble, making it a lovable rival.
The M4 Competition presents a luxury performance alternative to the Mustang GT, known for its distinctive inline-six engine sound and refinement.
The 370Z Nismo, while different in body style, delivers a sporty driving experience with a unique V6 exhaust note, appealing to enthusiasts who appreciate performance and sound.
